 First Alert Daily: Austin tracks an unsettled weather pattern through the end of the week 
 Tune in around 2 p.m. for an update 
 Mostly cloudy with rounds of light rain through the end of the week. By Austin Lowe Published : Nov. 18, 2026 at 1:51 PM EST | Updated : 16 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google TALLAHASSEE, Fla. (WCTV) - Rounds of showers with breezy conditions will continue through the end of the week. Clouds and showers will keep temperatures cooler in the 60s and low 70s. 
 Meteorologist Austin Lowe breaks down the rest of your workweek on First Alert Daily
